Django Tango
services.desc: is Richmond’s premier swing jazz guitar ensemble, formed by Russ Hanchin to celebrate the music of legendary French guitarist Django Reinhardt and the Quintette du Hot Club de France. Join us for a memorable evening of Romani and latin rhythms and infectious swing music that will inspire you to move. The group includes Allen Burris (clarinet/sax), Freddy Lau (violin/guitar), James Carrington Beard (guitar) and Carter Blough (acoustic bass). Jean Reinhardt (23 January 1910 - 16 May 1953), known by his Romani nickname Django, was a Belgian-born Romani jazz guitarist and composer who lived most of his life in France. He was one of the first major jazz talents to emerge in Europe

services.name: The Bad Plus Farewell Tour
services.desc: The Bad Plus are the ultimate originals. A democratic unit with a clear vision and a refusal to conform to convention. For the past two decades they have played with spirit and adventure, made their own rules and done so with a bold sense of creativity and intent. Avoiding easy categorization, The Bad Plus has won critical acclaim and a legion of fans worldwide with their unique sound and flair for live performance. Now in their 27TH year, The Bad Plus continue to push boundaries as founding members Reid Anderson (bass) and Dave King (drums) embark on a new piano-less incarnation of the band with Ben Monder (guitar) and Chris Speed (tenor saxophone) - instigating a new wave of excitement
